svg.title: Choose where a recording is transcribed
svg.desc: On this computer: Install a compatible local model once. Then transcribe offline without per-use API charges.; Through OpenAI: Use your configured API account. Audio is uploaded and usage is billed separately.. Review the transcript before relying on it. Sharing transcript text in online chat sends that text to the chat provider.
